driving_video.source: Mixkit #583 'Woman doing warm-up exercises' (https://mixkit.co/free-stock-video/woman-doing-warm-up-exercises-583/), same fixed crop as PR-VID-181 (x=140,y=20,377x676 -> 464x832), window retrimmed to 2.30-4.80s (was 3.0-4.2s)

frozen_inputs.resize_policy: Do not pre-resize; feed frozen files to each template's own load/resize path and record the effective generation geometry from the actual run.

seeds.derivation: First 14 and next 14 hex chars of the frozen driving video's SHA-256, interpreted as integers -- deterministic and reproducible, fixed before any generation, not chosen after seeing any output.
seeds.sampler_mode: fixed (control_after_generate='fixed', NOT 'randomize' -- the official templates default to 'randomize' and must be overridden per run)

run_matrix.frames: local-candidate window (paper-only leading hypothesis: 13 frames / 480x832, the proven-safe Wan2.2-Animate-14B local envelope from PR-VID-160C/175/180/181 on this same RTX 4070 Ti -- NOT independently verified for Wan-Animate-2, see Phase E budget)
run_matrix.cache: OFF (minimal documented graph change: bypass/remove the WanAnimate2Cache node from the shipped default graph)
run_matrix.purpose: local-candidate configuration effect, run remotely -- separates configuration effects from future hardware effects; not a reference arm; cannot establish Q1 alone

shared_settings_all_runs.note: Shipped template defaults, verified directly from the current Comfy-Org blueprint JSON (not documentation prose); unchanged except the pre-registered inputs/seeds/frame-count deviation and run 5's cache change.

stop_rule: If credits run out, stop in table order (1,2,3,4,5) and report what completed. No paid top-up.
cache_note: The shipped WanAnimate2Cache stores activations as lossy int8 -- runs 1-4 use this shipped default as-is; only run 5 disables it.
